pr_title: Fix hold note disappearing instantly without fade out
pr_body: Fix #7508 (this issue also mentions taiko drumroll but I cannot reproduce that)

issue_context.title: Mania holds and taiko drum roll fades are jarring
issue_context.body:
The short fade duration makes them appear as if they're popping out of existence immediately after a judgement.

To reproduce, in `osu.Game.Rulesets.Mania.Tests`:
1. Run `TestSceneColumn` or `TestSceneStage`.
2. Click the `hold note` step, then play the note that appears.

Taiko is not tested.

**osu!lazer version:** 2020.112.0
comments: Just to confirm, this is specific to the test scenes yes?

Not specific; The test scene only shows how to reproduce. Sorry about the wording.

And as I said, this also affects taiko drum rolls, but I didn’t test it.
It's not instant. It's fading, with a very short duration. In the case of mania, this is done as a stop-gap measure while we figure out a better animation for it.
Bumping up in priority. To me this is the number one most awkward part of mania at the moment.

review_comments:
If anyone else is as lost as I was as to why this is necessary, the explanation is here:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/521fbd2ea3b2a6d99d309871e10dd37337ebf299/osu.Game.Rulesets.Mania/Objects/Drawables/DrawableManiaHitObject.cs#L73-L85

It's a little weird that the entire hold note should be `IgnoreMiss`ed if and only if the tail is missed, but I don't suppose it matters too much so long as it does the job...?
